## [0.1.4] — 2026-08-27

### EN
- Dependency management unified on npm: `package-lock.json` committed; CI and publish install with `npm ci`; publish runner pinned to Node 22.19.
- Numeric CLI options (`--port`, `--local-port`, `--heartbeat`, `--lines`, `--release`) are validated — clear usage errors instead of silent fallbacks.
- systemd unit rendering hardened: `Environment=` values and the `ExecStart` binary quoted; quotes/newlines in paths rejected up front (verified with `systemd-analyze`).
- Added `CHANGELOG.md` (backfilled through 0.1.4).

### 中文
- 依赖管理统一到 npm:`package-lock.json` 入库,CI 与发布改用 `npm ci` 可复现构建,发布 runner 对齐 Node 22.19。
- CLI 数字参数(`--port`/`--local-port`/`--heartbeat`/`--lines`/`--release`)全部校验——非法输入给出明确报错,不再静默回退默认值。
- systemd unit 模板加固:`Environment=` 值与 `ExecStart` 二进制加引号,含引号/换行的路径前置拒绝(经 `systemd-analyze` 实测)。
- 新增 `CHANGELOG.md`(回填至 0.1.4)。
